clips.title: The story
paras: In the Undercity, Spellfire Robes mark a young Horde mage's rite of passage. Josef Gregorian, a tailor, completes the robes after the apprentice gathers rare components from across the realm.

In Lordaeron, you seek more than ordinary cloth to channel and shield your growing magic. Josef Gregorian works as a tailor in the Undercity's Magic Quarter, where he weaves magical garments from specialized materials gathered by promising Horde spellcasters. The final stitching marks your passage beyond basic incantations toward mastery of arcane and fire magic.

Josef Gregorian needs alchemical and arcane components to make robes that focus powerful magic. You gather those supplies through dangerous trials and bring them to his sanctum in the Undercity. There, Gregorian weaves them together, giving you a sign of growing status and protection as an aspiring mage.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Here are your robes, friend. Wear them well.
